name: Harness Config Writer
description: Deploys harness-native file and env config for codex, opencode, kilo, kilocode, claude, copilot, droid, gemini, iflow, kimi, kiro, qwen and pi. Supports providerKey routing and nativeConfig config/settings/models/catalog overlays for primary models plus native role, tool, review, memory and compaction fields without CLI onboarding. Additive to bundled acpx: absence of a harness id writes NOTHING — vendor auth runs unchanged.

providerPolicies.description: Optional HCW-owned policy overrides keyed by the exact gateway models.providers key. Keeps modelPolicy out of the strict gateway provider schema. Supports contextWindowFactor, autoCompactFactor, postTurnCompactThresholdPercent and the documented model policy metadata.

harnesses.description: Normalized per-harness config for the supported ids codex, opencode, kilo, kilocode, claude, copilot, droid, gemini, iflow, kimi, kiro, qwen and pi. HCW generates native config files and harness-env/<id>.env sourced by the plugins.entries.acpx.config.agents.<id>.command/args override. providerKey selects an explicit gateway provider; nativeConfig config/settings/models/catalog objects deep-merge native overlays. Native files include Codex config.toml + model-catalog.json, Pi models.json + settings.json, Kilo kilo.json, Kimi config.toml and the other harnesses' native JSON settings. ABSENCE of a harness id (or this whole section) = plugin writes NOTHING for it: native subscriptions and vendor OAuth run unchanged via bundled acpx. Changes apply on next boot.

model.description: Required, non-empty: the model id to claim for this harness.

baseUrl.description: Backend base URL (Ollama/vLLM/LocalAI/llama.cpp or a compatible remote route). Required for Codex/OpenCode/Kilo/Pi file routing; appended with /v1 exactly once where the harness expects it. Other harnesses use their native settings file and/or documented env variables.

apiKey.description: API key/token the harness backend expects (auth.json OPENAI_API_KEY for codex, apiKey option for opencode, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN/KIRO_API_KEY/... for env harnesses). Placeholder 'ollama' when omitted.

thinking.description: Primary reasoning/effort level where the native harness schema supports it (Codex, Claude, Pi, Qwen, Droid and Kimi). Unsupported levels are warned about and omitted.

smallModel.description: OpenCode/Kilo small_model and Claude ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL. This is not a utility_model alias; other role models use their explicit nativeConfig fields.

models.description: Optional available model ids; the required 'model' stays the default. A non-empty explicit list wins over gateway auto-matching; an explicit empty list opts out; an absent list auto-matches all models of the provider whose baseUrl matches (deduped, capped at 200, fail-soft). Written to each harness's native model/catalog surface where one exists.

providerKey.description: Optional explicit gateway models.providers key. If omitted, HCW uses a unique baseUrl match or a unique model + wire-API route match; URL-derived fallback IDs are used only with a warning for ambiguous routes.

nativeConfig.description: Explicit native overlay with separate target objects: config (Codex/OpenCode/kilo/kilocode/Claude/Kimi primary config), settings (Claude/Pi/Qwen/Gemini/Copilot/Droid/Kiro/iFlow settings), models (Pi models.json) and catalog (Codex model catalog). Objects are deep-merged after generated defaults. Use native fields directly for review_model, default_subagent_model, subagent_model, memory_model, fastModel, defaultTools, tools, agents, compaction and other harness functions; no utility_model aliasing. Unsupported target/harness combinations produce warnings; unknown target names are rejected by the strict schema.
